title: Tactical commands
description: Commands a tactical controller returns for an activation: the same set a player issues. The tactical layer validates and resolves each; illegal commands are rejected. There is no takeCover command: taking cover is move / changeStance, or setReaction with reaction takeCover (TAI-005). Spec: TAI-002, TAI-005, TAI-006, TAI-012, TAI-013, TAI-016, TAC-005..TAC-084.

commands.description: Exactly one command per call; TAC calls again after resolving it (TAI-002, spec choice)

blackboardWrites.description: TAI-012 (spec choice): applied by TAC in order when it receives the answer, without interpreting them

op.description: add* with an existing id replaces that entry; remove* of an unknown id is ignored; setPlan replaces roles and intent and is applied only when the call's activeUnit is the current leader (TAC-094), else dropped

plan.description: setPlan: {roles, intent}; TAC adds leader, setBy, setTurn (perception view $defs.squadPlan)

request.description: Same shape as the perception view $defs.request

claim.description: Same shape as the perception view $defs.claim

unit.description: Active unit; null for the choice of whom to activate

rejection.description: TAI-005: the rejection this call answers (copied from the view's rejection)

slot.description: swapWeapon: weapon slot to switch to; holster = the battle belt's pistol (TAC-042)

shells.description: reload, tube-fed: shells to load (partial reload)

unit.description: activate: unit to activate; useItem: treated soldier (self or adjacent); restrainVip: the VIP

path.description: move: the tiles {x, y, level} to walk, or only the destination tile, which TAC reaches along the previewed path of that allowedActions reachable entry (TAI-005, TAC-037)

target.description: shoot: target unit ID; search, pickUp, cutLock, placeCharge, pickUpBackpack, liftBody: object or body ID

tile.description: shoot at a tile, throwGrenade target, vault or climb point

edge.description: closeDoor: the door's tile edge {tile, side} (TAC-084); a closed unlocked door on a move path opens as part of the move

item.description: throwGrenade, useItem, pickUp, placeCharge: item instance

sourceSlot.description: Equipment slot the item or magazine comes from (backpack surcharge, TAC-068)

exit.description: leaveMap: exit id from the tactical map request / map (TAC-038)
